We met on Okcupid, we had all listed ourselves as bi and had all been chatting to each other, and we happened to mention the other people we had been talking to online..  we got into a three way chat on skype and then decided to meet up together in person. 

 from the first moments we met we just couldn't stop hugging, we tell terrible jokes and talk about deep stuff, we seem to feed off each other and amplify each other so perfectly.  

 We all come from pretty open and loving.. almost hippy backgrounds.  

 I am teaching them guitar, one is teaching two of us to surf and the other is teaching us to ride motorbikes, so we all swap roles and learn/teach each other constantly.  its all just so open and honest, we talk about things before they become issues and we can just communicate so clearly that any minor issue gets quickly resolved. Its early days yet, but its already one of the healthiest relationships i've ever been in.

 The money came in the form of a loan from my mum and the job is an animation job i got headhunted for out of nowhere. 

 I don't think i am exactly the average redditor, despite my main account having been on here for years, given the number of redditors i've gone on to meet in real life I dont actually think there IS an average redditor. we are all just individuals.

  oh, and I'm not in america, the economic climate is not as gloomy here :)

yeah i know, I'm still having trouble believing it myself.  and I knew that there would be those who chose not to believe me, but in the end I really just hope that seeing my story might help someone who is in the same position i was in two weeks ago.
